adjudication.selection: spa.LUK-1-26-38 (guide spa-luk-p3-v1.0.1) was chosen as the first eligible untagged unit for a visual manual case under this batch's guard, which admits only units whose compiled HTML carries no resource tag. Earlier Spanish Luke units that name Galilea carry resource tags (for example spa-luk-p1-v1.1, Luke 1:1-4, S05-U003 with a FIAKeyTerms reference) and are outside this guard. No claim is made about Galilea, or about any visual, being absent elsewhere in the current source.
adjudication.method: Manual, unit by unit, from the retained archive only (no outside read). A unit is associate only when its own text asks the group to look at a picture, map or video that is one of the pack's catalog candidates, cited by typed identity. A unit that names a place, person or term without asking for a visual is none. A unit that asks for a visual absent from the pack catalog is unresolved and is not gold. No visual is invented. Rows count as gold only after an independent reviewer accepts the exact text.

evidence.reason: Historical background naming Nazaret and the region of Galilea. The unit gives no instruction to look at or show any picture, map or video; naming a place is not a visual request.
